_readme: The Wall of Thanks, shown behind the rotating crown at the bottom-left of the app.
Add a person when their feedback turns into something that actually shipped.
One object per person; a person can hold several contributions.
Fields: name (required), note (optional one-liner about them),
This file is served statically and fetched at runtime, so editing it and
redeploying is all it takes — no code change needed.

contributors.name: mchude
contributors.note: Asked the question that turned a leaderboard into a profile.

contributions.title: The Superfan tab
contributions.detail: Suggested a per-channel view with a picker at the top, so you can choose any channel and see your whole history with it — not just the ones that crack the all-time top ten.
